items.title: SpaceX completes $60B acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor
items.note: Largest startup acquisition on record, Cursor becomes SpaceXAI with access to the Colossus GPU supercluster

items.title: Writer launches Palmyra X6, claims 52% lower cost for AI agent workloads
items.note: Prices at $2/$8 per million tokens, undercutting Claude Opus and GPT-5.5 on agentic tasks

items.title: Fix-and-flip market shows signs of strain as mortgage rates climb
items.note: Q2 Fix and Flip Market Index falls to 59, second straight quarterly decline, margins hit hardest in the Southwest and Texas

items.title: Mortgage rates fall again as FHA and VA delinquencies rise
items.note: 30-year conforming rate drops to 6.86% even as FHA/VA delinquencies climb, MBA applications up 3.6%

items.title: Anthropic in talks to acquire Israeli AI startup Decart for $6 billion
items.note: Would be Anthropic's largest acquisition ever and its first in Israel, Decart builds real-time AI video generation
